verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੭ : ਜਗਤ ਦੇ ਰੁਝੇਵੇਂ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸ਼ਬਦ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 7 : jagat dhe rujheve(n) te gur shabadh

en.bdb: The obsessions with the world and the Guru word

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਸਤ ਸੰਜਮ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਦਾਨ ਪੁੰਨ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: jat sat sa(n)jam hom jag jap tap dhaan pu(n)n bahutere|

en.bdb: Hypocrisy by and large enters into the praxis of continence, burnt offerings, feasts, penances and gifts.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਬਹੁ ਤੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਅਗਲੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: ridh sidh nidh paakha(n)dd bahu ta(n)tr ma(n)tr naaTak agalere|

en.bdb: Incantations and spells ultimately  turn out to be hypocritical plays.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੀਰਾਰਾਧਣ ਜੋਗਣੀ ਮੜ੍ਹੀ ਮਸਾਣ ਵਿਡਾਣ ਘਨੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: veeraaraadhan joganee maRhee masaan viddaan ghanere|

en.bdb: The worship of the fifty-two heroes, of the eight yoginis of cemeteries and of places of cremation leads to  whopping dissimulation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਕ ਕੁੰਭਕ ਰੇਚਕਾ ਨਿਵਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮ ਘੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: poorak ku(n)bhak rechakaa nivalee karam bhuia(n)gam ghere|

en.bdb: People are obsessed with the pranayam exercises of the inhalation, suspension of breath, the exhalation, the niolr feat and  straightening of kundalini the serpent power.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧਾਸਣ ਪਰਚੇ ਘਣੇ ਹਠ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕਉਤਕ ਲਖ ਹੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: sidhaasan parache ghane haTh nigreh kautak lakh here|

en.bdb: Many employ themselves in  sitting in the siddhasanas and thus we have seen them seeking myriad miracles.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸ ਮਣੀ ਰਸਾਇਣਾ ਕਰਾਮਾਤ ਕਾਲਖ ਆਨ੍ਹੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: paaras manee rasainaa karaamaat kaalakh aanhere|

en.bdb: The belief in the philospher's stone, the jewel in the serpent's  head and the miracle of life immortalising elixir are nothing but the  darkness of ignorance.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਵਰਤ ਉਪਾਰਣੇ ਵਰ ਸਰਾਪ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤਿ ਲਵੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: poojaa varat upaarane var saraap siv sakat lavere|

en.bdb: People are engaged in the worship of idols of gods  and goddesses, in fasting, uttering and giving blessings and curses.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਵਿਣੁ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਭਲੇ ਭਲੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh vin thaau na pain bhale bhalere|

en.bdb: But  without the holy congregation of the saints and the recitation of the Guru- sabad even the very good person cannot find acceptance.
The  superstitions bind themselves with a hundred knots of falsehood.
